messages.subject: strange behavior of scale_x_date
parts:
hey list

what i thought would be a very straightforward declaration of one axis as dates has become a real challenge.

Some toy data:

tv6 <- data.frame(Date = as.Date(as.Date("2012-08-16", origin = "1970-01-01"): as.Date("2012-10-01", origin = "1970-01-01"), origin = "1970-01-01"),
                  Num = sample(1:7, 47, replace = T), 
                  Category = "Amer ID")

and this ggplot call works fine

 ggplot(tv6, aes(y = Category, x = Date, size = Num)) +
               geom_point()

which produces:

But if I make the innocuous change of simply trying to formally declare the x-axis a date

ggplot(tv6, aes(y = Category, x = Date, size = Num)) +
                geom_point() +
                scale_x_date()

I get the following error:


Error in ggplot(tv6, aes(y = Category, x = Date, size = Num)) + geom_point() +  : 
  non-numeric argument to binary operator
In addition: Warning message:
Incompatible methods ("+.ggplot", "Ops.date") for "+" 


what's going on here? all help appreciated!
